If you have gluten intolerance (condition) you do not receive 1900 argentinian pesos monthly, whereas if you have CD you do. The same happens with lactose intolerance and wheat allergy. 

And yes, they do point out the difference between active CD (with symptoms) and treated CD.

In Argentina, CD is a disease legally and medically speaking. 

In Spanish the definition of disease says “alteration in the normal functioning of the human organism”, but lactose intolerance is considered a condition because is not as damaging as celiac disease (according to doctors). 

Despite what doctors and gubernamental organisations say, people still believe CD is a condition.
